organizations.name: Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)
organizations.notes: Official 2026 notifications, 2026 and 2027 calendars and annual reports used. CMS, IES/ISS, CGS and EPFO tests pending.

organizations.name: Staff Selection Commission (SSC)
organizations.notes: CGL, CHSL, JE, Stenographer and CHT from official 2026 notices; CPO and GD from secondary reports. MTS excluded (Level 1 pay). Selection Posts pending.

organizations.name: Railway Recruitment Boards (RRB) and RPF
organizations.notes: RRB PDFs block automated download; secondary reports used for cycle figures. Group D and ALP excluded (pay below Rs 20,000).

organizations.name: Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS)
organizations.notes: PO from the official 2026 notice; Clerk and RRB from secondary reports. SO pending.

organizations.name: Reserve Bank of India
organizations.notes: Grade B from a secondary report. Assistant pending.

organizations.name: Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC)
organizations.notes: Official 2026 notifications. ASO, HWO, AMVI, Horticulture and others notified in 2026 but not yet profiled. FRO (5 posts) skipped as a minor cycle.

organizations.name: State Level Police Recruitment Board, AP
organizations.notes: Six notifications of 16 Sep 2026; details from a secondary report because the official press note is a scanned image.

organizations.name: School Education Department, AP (DSC, TET)
organizations.notes: DSC 2026 and TET 2026 from secondary reports of official notifications.

organizations.name: Telangana Public Service Commission (TGPSC)
organizations.notes: Official notifications. Small 2026 cycles (DEO/Gazetted HM 24 posts, DIET lecturers about 45, TGPCB AEE 19, Asst. Director Town Planning 10) left out as less preferred.

organizations.name: Department of School Education, Telangana (TET, DSC)
organizations.notes: TET and DSC from secondary reports. DSC 2026 not notified at research time.

organizations.name: Telangana State Level Police Recruitment Board
organizations.notes: Police Recruitment 2026 (7,437 posts) from the official TGPRB press note of 8 Sep 2026.

organizations.name: AP power utilities (APTRANSCO, APGENCO, DISCOMs)
organizations.notes: 2026 AEE recruitment from a secondary report.

organizations.name: Karnataka Public Service Commission (KPSC)
organizations.notes: KAS, FDA, SDA and technical posts pending.

District-level and contract recruitments (anganwadi, outsourcing, home guards).
gaps: Official category-wise cutoffs were collected only where the PDF was reachable (UPSC CSE 2024).
Several 2026 cycle figures (CPO, GD, IBPS Clerk, IBPS RRB, RBI Grade B, AP police, TG TET) come from secondary reports and are marked so.
Karnataka HRA rates under the 2024 pay scales and the AP 10% HRA slab ceiling were not confirmed from official orders.
Bank and RBI gross pay is not modelled because DA there changes every quarter.
